c1_blocker.finding: Production-profile explicit C1 K3 D24 collapses at resident capacity >= 2: MTP 15.753 -> ~8.5 tok/s (1.418x -> ~0.75x own AR), draft acceptance 0.7889 -> 0.1523, and greedy AR equality 10/10 -> 0/10 (mtp_self_exact still 10/10). C3/C4 measured in the same run are healthy and bit-stable versus the pinned head (acceptance 0.7889/0.7800, equality 10/10).
c1_blocker.correction_2026_09_03: The original attribution below ('B1 rows>1 owner at the R4 packed shape') was FALSIFIED by a capacity x flag measurement matrix at the same head: (A) capacity 3 with HIPENGINE_GGUF_MTP_SERVING_TARGET_WMMA_PREFILL=0 stays broken (8.443 tok/s, acceptance 0.1523, 0/10); (B) capacity 1 with the flag forced ON is healthy (18.111 tok/s, 1.6255x, acceptance 0.7889, 10/10); (C) capacity 3 with HIPENGINE_GGUF_PREFILL_F16_STAGING=0 stays broken (8.342, 0.1523, 0/10); the earlier env=0 'restoration' (18.168) ran at capacity 1 and was capacity-confounded. The collapse is therefore flag-independent and staging-independent, gated by resident capacity: the width-1 group routes through the packed batch verifier (verify_target_blocks_batch, single 4-row job) at capacity >= 2, while the capacity-1 route (single-block/native path) is healthy. Deterministic acceptance 0.1523 (69/453) identical across all four owner-family states indicates a fixed numerics divergence in the packed batch-verify dataflow at 4 rows, not an owner-family defect. Regression window b768516f2..HEAD (packed-verify-touching commits include 5f7b3cb6b, 3f5726944, bb38765fc, 6a3c5303d, 765409ad1, 98294239e, b1b3a62de, ae63357e3, 4fc772269).
c1_blocker.attribution_superseded: Original claim kept for the record: rerunning C1 at the same commit with HIPENGINE_GGUF_MTP_SERVING_TARGET_WMMA_PREFILL=0 restored MTP to 18.167868 tok/s (1.58220x own AR), acceptance 0.78894, and AR equality 10/10 — but that arm ran at resident capacity 1, so it demonstrated the capacity-1 route's health, not flag causality.
c1_blocker.scope: Opt-in explicit diagnostic route at resident capacity >= 2. Capacity-1 width-1 serving measured healthy under both flag states. Strict C1 automatic serving was confirmed unchanged at the B5 default confirmation (6d6fb3ed3); C2-C8 remain automatic K0.
c1_blocker.registered_opt_out: none effective: the flag opt-out does not restore capacity >= 2 (arm A) and catastrophically slows C3 one-group (2.577 tok/s); the B2 staging opt-out does not restore it either (arm C).
c1_blocker.follow_up: Resolved by routing an active singleton through the existing request-local transactional target verifier while retaining the wide physical NextN provider and packed target path for C2+. Repairing packed R4 itself is no longer required for the selected route.
c1_blocker.resolution_2026_09_03: Commit b58a70c82 restores capacity-3 C1 to 19.428 tok/s (1.6868x own AR), acceptance 0.7889, and 10/10 AR equality; C3 packed collateral is 32.919 tok/s with unchanged acceptance and 10/10 equality. See benchmarks/results/2026-09-03-gfx1151-qwen38-c1-singleton-target-retained.json.

decision: Numbers are retainable as the current snapshot for docs surfaces. The C1 regression is recorded as a named blocker with a registered opt-out and a scoped follow-up; no dispatch change is made in this unit.
